messages:
Erin: thinking about a lightweight capability handshake between gateway and model metadata so routing rules can ask for features (streaming, fn-calls, kvcache) and get a deterministic fallback.
Vikram: +1. we already have alias metadata but its not checked at route-eval time. gateway just routes by alias string.
Erin: right — proposal: gateway adds header `X-Requested-Capabilities: streaming,fn_call` and aliases publish `capabilities: streaming,fn_call,kv-v1`. routing can then pick a compatible alias or trigger fallback policy.
Sam: curious about semantics: if requested capabilities subset(alias.capabilities) -> ok. else -> try fallback alias order, then maybe degrade to hosted smaller model?
Vikram: exactly. fallback order: 1) same alias with lower version that supports the features, 2) alias tagged `compatible-with:<features>` , 3) default old fallback model.
Natalie: console UX: show the handshake result in the route trace pane (reason codes + which alias was chosen). users should be able to pin the chosen fallback or opt-out of fallback to avoid data quality surprises.
Erin: good point. need a short reason code set: `ok`, `missing_capability`, `quota_block`, `pin_override`, `fallback_used`. expose in telemetry and decision logs.
Sam: quotas interact here — what if fallback is allowed but quota would exceed tenant commit? Should we prefer a cheaper variant or return 429?
Vikram: policy options: a) prefer cheaper variant, b) prefer pinned model even if quota, c) fail fast. default = fail-fast unless tenant has `fallback_allow=true` flag. Admin console toggle.
Natalie: add a UI affordance: when a fallback is used show an inline banner: "Routed to compatible variant due to missing feature. Click to view alternatives / request pin."
console-bot: /compat-check running against alias matrix -> alias redwood-llama-v2 lacks `fn_call` capability.
Erin: thanks infra-bot. so we need a migration story for aliases that advertise incomplete capability sets. maybe a small shim that maps capability tags so older aliases can opt into compatibility flags.
Sam: could also add a routing-expression helper that does `requires(fn_call)` and fails evaluation if no match. devs can use that when fn_call is essential.
Vikram: implementation notes: keep handshake cheap — header only, no extra roundtrip. gateway has local alias cache with capabilities and TTL. decision logs include `reason_code` and `alias_metadata_version` for audit.
Erin: telemetry: metric names: `routing.decisions.total`, tags: `reason_code`, `tenant`, `route`, `alias_chosen`. add histogram for time-to-decision.
Natalie: product note: show recent `missing_capability` events per route in the console and surface suggested model pins (auto-suggest top 3 compatible models).
Sam: QA / experiments: run canary on 5% of traffic where fallback_allow=true and log user-visible errors to detect quality regressions.
Erin: action items: Vikram -> prototype gateway header check + cache (P1), Sam -> quota-policy matrix doc (P1), Natalie -> console mockups for decision trace + banner (P2). I'll open tracking tickets.
Vikram: will also add detailed decision log fields: `requested_capabilities`, `alias_capabilities`, `chosen_alias`, `fallback_chain` (comma list).
Sam: one more: include a short example header + alias metadata to standardize with SDKs:
```
Request header: X-Requested-Capabilities: streaming,fn_call
Alias metadata: capabilities: streaming,fn_call,kvcache-v2
```
Natalie: love it. ping me when mocks are up.
Erin: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
